android.desc:
Meet Violoncello, a powerful text-only web browser for Android! This app is great for reading text-heavy webpages such as articles and blog posts, as it removes annoyances such as ads and videos. It's easy to share websites in your main browser to Violoncello, and you can bookmark websites for easy access within the app.

Violoncello offers several settings and tweaks, and you can upgrade to the premium version to change the font and the text, background, navigation bar, and loading spinner colors. With a wide variety of features, customization options, and a simple user interface, Violoncello is a great way to read content on the web without distractions!
